verdict.rationale: Anytype documents its own block editor: composable text blocks, Toggled Headings that collapse content, and Inline LaTeX. A co-founder confirms simple tables (no formulas), and users describe the app as polished and smooth. Callouts, code blocks, embedded media blocks and keyboard-driven editing (slash commands, shortcuts, markdown shortcuts) are not evidenced. missing for 10: callout blocks, code blocks, embedded media (video/audio/file) blocks, keyboard-driven editing such as slash commands or shortcuts, independent hands-on evidence of editor speed.
